mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post ( board_id, author_id, category_id, title, content, is_secret, secret_password_hash, is_pinned, comments_locked, view_count, version ) VALUES ( #{boardId}, #{authorId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{isSecret}, #{secretPasswordHash}, #{isPinned}, #{commentsLocked}, #{viewCount}, #{version} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.author_id AS authorId, m.display_name AS authorDisplayName, p.category_id AS categoryId, bc.name AS categoryName, p.is_secret AS secret, p.is_pinned AS pinned, p.view_count AS viewCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment c WHERE c.post_id = p.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ) AS commentCount, p.created_at AS createdAt FROM post p INNER JOIN member m ON m.id = p.author_id LEFT JOIN board_category bc ON bc.id = p.category_id WHERE p.board_id = #{boardId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.is_pinned DESC, p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post WHERE board_id = #{boardId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT p.id, p.board_id AS boardId, p.title, p.content, p.author_id AS authorId, m.display_name AS authorDisplayName, p.category_id AS categoryId, bc.name AS categoryName, p.is_secret AS secret, p.secret_password_hash AS secretPasswordHash, p.is_pinned AS pinned, p.comments_locked AS commentsLocked, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.version, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM post p INNER JOIN member m ON m.id = p.author_id LEFT JOIN board_category bc ON bc.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.board_id = #{boardId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_secret = #{isSecret}, secret_password_hash = #{secretPasswordHash}, comments_locked = #{commentsLocked}, version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND board_id = #{boardId} AND author_id = #{authorId} AND version = #{version} AND deleted_at IS NULL
